answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in signal, verified in yarrow, and wharf names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 43 submissions per epoch. That bill is paid per identity, so 149 aliases cost 59 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
